title: Honeydale Residence: gated cluster homes without strata rules.
location: Taman Impian Emas, Johor Bahru, Johor
videoTitle: PROPERTY REVIEW #417 | HONEYDALE RESIDENCE, TAMAN IMPIAN EMAS JB
excerpt: Freehold, individual-title cluster homes in a guarded enclave around a 4-acre park in Taman Impian Emas. Sean admires the site plan and generous design, but notes some awkward details and the quiet surroundings for now.
takeaways: Freehold 34 by 70 ft cluster homes from about RM1.24 to RM1.43 million.
Individual titles with a guardhouse, while the council maintains roads and the park.
First-phase clusters bought at about RM900,000 have transacted at about RM1.1 million two years on.

sections.heading: What sets it apart
paragraphs: Honeydale is a gated cluster-home enclave on individual titles. Owners sign a deed of mutual covenant for a guardhouse, while the city council maintains the roads, street lights and a park of more than 4 acres with a playground, futsal court and lake. Cul-de-sacs mean no house faces a junction, and a water feature greets you at the entrance.

Each 34 by 70 ft unit shares its land with three others and opens to the front and one side. Inside there are 12 ft ceilings, a 6.6 m living and dining space with tall windows, a downstairs bedroom, separate dry and wet kitchens behind a glass door, a helper's room, three-phase power, and three upstairs bedrooms each with an en-suite bathroom.

sections.heading: Where it is
paragraphs: Honeydale is part of the 3,000-acre Taman Impian Emas township off Jalan Bukit Impian, favoured by local Johoreans rather than cross-border commuters. Its golf course, bungalows, commercial centre and Southern University College are 5 to 10 minutes away, a future road will connect directly, and the growing heavy-industry area nearby is drawing workers. The immediate surroundings are still largely undeveloped, with earthworks under way for future phases.

sections.heading: Rent and returns
paragraphs: Prices run from about RM1.24 million to RM1.43 million; semi-detached homes at about RM1.9 million have sold out, and link houses in the township sell for about RM800,000 to RM900,000. First-phase clusters bought at about RM900,000 have transacted at about RM1.1 million two years later.

standout.title: Guarded, but without strata rules
standout.body: Owners keep individual titles and renovate with only council approval, yet the development is gated. The council keeps maintaining the roads and park, while residents fund only the guardhouse. Sean calls it the best of both worlds: security without hefty fees, a clubhouse or management rules.

pros: The developer: what looks isolated is part of the long-running Taman Impian Emas master plan, by a team that has built many landed projects and is launching several at once.

The design: no house faces a junction, cul-de-sacs and split roads for privacy, the park and lake built first, and generous 34 ft cluster homes with front and side facades, oversized windows, spacious rooms and well-placed beams. He even likes the pitched roofs.
The ownership: individual titles that the council helps keep gated, so ownership costs stay low and owners can renovate freely.
cons: The same individual titles mean owners may tear out the carefully designed facades as soon as they get the keys, and he expects a full strata landed project here eventually.

Design details: timber-style stair railings that owners will struggle to design around, steps between the car porch, living area and downstairs bathroom, and two bedroom doors crowding the top of the stairs to give every upstairs room its own bathroom.
The surroundings feel isolated and quiet compared with busier areas nearby, which only makes sense once you see the whole master plan.

closing: A well-planned, low-cost-to-own landed home for local Johor families, in a market where landed homes keep appreciating.
sourceNote: Based on Sean's full English captions for this December 2025 episode and its video description. The 3 on 3 follows the three things he likes and the three he doesn't, in his order, at the end of the video. The developer's team showed Sean the show unit, a mock-up unit and the site; prices are the team's, and the first-phase transactions are as he quoted them.
